title: Ordering food by phone
instructions: Nick telefonda yemek sipariş ediyor. Siparişi, değişikliği ve teslim süresini takip et.

script.speaker: shop
script.text: Good evening, Golden Dragon. What would you like to order?

script.speaker: nick
script.text: Hi. Can I have two chicken noodles and one vegetable rice, please?

script.speaker: nick
script.text: Three bottles of water. Oh, and change one chicken noodles to beef, please.

script.speaker: shop
script.text: So, one chicken noodles, one beef noodles, one vegetable rice and three waters.

script.speaker: nick
script.text: That's right. How long will it take?

script.speaker: shop
script.text: About forty-five minutes. We're very busy tonight.

script.speaker: nick
script.text: OK. Can I pay by card when it arrives?

script.speaker: shop
script.text: Sorry, our driver only takes cash.

questions.prompt: How many drinks does Nick order?
questions.feedback: Üç şişe su (three bottles of water) istiyor.
Bir tavuklu eriştesini dana etli (beef) yapıyor.
questions.evidence: change one chicken noodles to beef, please.

questions.prompt: Why will the food take forty-five minutes?
options: The food is difficult to cook.
questions.feedback: Bu akşam çok yoğunlar (very busy tonight).
Kurye sadece nakit (cash) alıyor; Nick'in nakdi var.
questions.evidence: Sorry, our driver only takes cash.
